sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्ट कर्मणः ।द्वास्स्थः कुमारावाहूय राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। ७.८३.१ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṁ tasya rāmasyākliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ ।dvāssthaḥ kumārāvāhūya rāghavāya nyavedayat ।। 7.83.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Rama, whose deeds were effortless, the doorkeeper called the two princes and announced their arrival to Raghava.
